name: Chicago, IL
local_rules: The Department of Finance describes correspondence hearings and separate windows for a new ticket and a Notice of Violation.

appeal_mail_address.department: City of Chicago Department of Administrative Hearings

verification_metadata.notes: The official eHearing FAQ distinguishes the issuance window from the later notice window. It describes correspondence hearings without establishing a mailing address.
verification_metadata.last_change: Replaced the payment-page lead and corrected the initial window.

special_requirements.notes: Online hearing request via chicago.gov/account; mail-in options available through DOF

confirmation_note: The City gives you 7 days from issuance to contest. A later Notice of Violation gives you 21 days to request a hearing. Check which document you received.
